title: Completeness of an actual completed Z_l line
statement: Let l be a prime and S a Noetherian scheme. Fix the derived localizations of [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models]. Let L be a locally free module sheaf of rank one over the actual completed coefficient ring purTwistZlCompletion(S,l) [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit]. Its degree-zero complex has complete underlying constant coefficients: for every V in D(S_proet,ULift Z_l) on which l times the identity is invertible, Hom(V,diagonalCompletedUnderlying(l,S)(L[0])) is a subsingleton. This includes the regular coefficient module and the empty scheme. It assumes no invertibility of l on S and specifies no Tate line, shift or direct image.

proof.text: From finite local freeness of rank one, choose a covering family on each pro-etale object and convert the local free rank-one isomorphisms to isomorphisms with the regular completed coefficient module.
Apply the local descent completeness theorem to this covering family.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalCompletedLine_complete (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (S : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian S] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    (L : DiagonalCompleted l S) (hL : L.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank 1) :
    ∀ V : DerivedCategory (DiagonalMod l S), IsIso (l • 𝟙 V) →
      Subsingleton (V ⟶ (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l S).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalCompleted l S) 0).obj L))
